Roles and permissions

Each invited vendor or speaker edits their own submission. Event staff review requirements. The public program shows only approved publication fields.

Build prompt

Build “Event Vendor & Speaker Portal” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Assign a checklist by participant type. Track missing or expired certificates privately and route approved bios and headshots into the public program. Each invited vendor or speaker edits their own submission. Event staff review requirements. The public program shows only approved publication fields. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

A speaker supplies a bio and headshot. A vendor missing insurance remains incomplete. Publishing the speaker profile exposes neither the vendor certificate nor private contact details.
